title: SPARC Cat - Sham Control Chronic Cat 1 Day 30
author: Brett Hanzlicek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfztjp6n
materials: Transport cat from housing site to surgery site.
Cleveland Clinic animal team euthanizes the animal

steps.title: Prepare Animal for Surgery
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the cat, shave the abdomen, and move the animal to the surgery room to be attached to monitors.

steps.title: Sterilize Surgical Site
steps.instruction: Drape the animal and perform a betadine scrub on the abdomen and genitals.

steps.title: Insert Bladder Catheter
steps.instruction: Insert a 3.5Fr catheter into the bladder through the urethra using surgilube.

substeps.instruction: Advance the catheter until resistance is met

steps.title: Collect Urine Sample
steps.instruction: Use gentle suction with a syringe to withdraw urine from the bladder through the catheter.

substeps.instruction: Measure the volume and save the urine for urinalysis

steps.title: Perform Contrast CT Imaging
steps.instruction: Visualize the bladder using a 1:5 dilution of contrast to saline.

substeps.instruction: Fill the bladder with 10 mL contrast and take a single CT image
Add 10 mL more (total 20 mL) and take a single CT image
Add 10 mL more (total 30 mL) and take a single CT image
Take a 3D CT image with 30 mL contrast:saline in the bladder

steps.title: Setup Urodynamics Recording
steps.instruction: Transfer the cat from Isoflurane to propofol anesthetic and configure the pressure recording system.

substeps.instruction: Connect an external pressure transducer to a syringe pump on one end and tubing leading to the catheter on the other
Set up data recording using Labview software
Set syringe pump fill rate to 2 mL saline/minute

steps.title: Perform Urodynamic Pressure Measurements
steps.instruction: Fill the bladder with saline and record pressure using the pressure transducer and LabView.

substeps.instruction: Fill to 13.9 mL (Peak pressure approx 20 cmH2O)
Fill to 20 mL (Peak pressure approx 34 cmH2O)
Tug on the catheter after filling to visualize contraction in Labview software

steps.title: Complete Final Urodynamic Round
steps.instruction: Continue filling the bladder with saline at 2 mL/min.

substeps.instruction: Fill to 15 mL to end round 2 urodynamics

steps.title: Harvest Bladder
steps.instruction: Remove the bladder, examine it, and place it in formalin for histological analysis.
